article.story: HUNTSVILLE, Texas -- — Erik Makke, Kobi Pearson and Narit Chotikavanic each had 10 points in Stephen F. Austin’s 89-32 victory over Texas Lutheran on Friday. Makke shot 3 for 8, including 2 for 6 from beyond the arc for the Lumberjacks (2-0). Chotikavanic went 4 of 6 (2 for 3 from 3-point range). Pearson finished 4 of 6. Carter Lewis led the Bulldogs in scoring, finishing with eight points. Up next SFA visits Abilene Christian in its next matchup on Wednesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
